scope: Current actual project event latency observations after typed snapshot boundaries. No new product change or speedup claim. One sequential automated CDP capture per project; no concurrent builds, checks, inference or other browser sampler.

mapped_cpu.scope: Post-process original sampled profiles using existing hidden source maps after checking every served JavaScript bundle byte-for-byte against the immutable deployment. No new execution or changed browser assets; sampled self time includes native/program/GC/automation entries, not exclusive event latency.

correlated_slow_events.scope: Source-mapped sampled self time selected by the original trace interval, not a complete instruction trace or physical paint measurement. FunctionCall intervals may be nested in EventDispatch and cannot be added.

projects.methodology: Real GUI pointer/wheel/click events with CDP dispatch spans and sampled CPU profiles. Input-to-two-rAF is a presentation proxy, not measured physical presentation or INP. Nested trace spans overlap and must not be summed as exclusive CPU time. Profiling and automation add overhead; one controlled desktop run is not a field percentile.

validation.scope: Previously completed gates on the same exact executable and unchanged served browser assets. This audit adds observations/documents, with no further product source changes.

limits: CDP EventDispatch is synchronous inclusive handler work, not end-to-end asynchronous paint.
Two requestAnimationFrame callbacks are a presentation proxy, not physical presentation or field INP.
Two drill wheel events and one Fit View event are maxima/individual observations, not population percentiles. Resize deliveries coalesce.
CPU samples include native/program/GC/automation observations and may miss short functions. Nested FunctionCall/EventDispatch spans overlap; do not add them.
Native current-thread CPU excludes child-process CPU; wall minus that value is not an I/O-wait measurement.
Empty event/queue observations are unavailable, not zero. Host/project/OS caches and installed Lean are retained; this is not a cold-install or live-model pilot.
